title: Make the mailer work locally
description: Gives the mailer config defaults so the app starts without a .env file. Renames logger to log in three services. Small extras in the same PR: the save button now reads Save changes, toCsv takes a separator, displayName prefers a nickname, byDate can sort newest first, retry gets an exponential backoff helper with a 250 ms base, and CONTRIBUTING says to run the tests.
